commits.message:
Added screenshots for v0.7.0

also version number bump in the package.appxmanifest file.

Updated certificate

So, my SSD died and ever since then, Windows doesn't acknowledge this certificate anymore... so I have a new one, which users need to import again into their trusted certificates folder because... well, why not, eh, Microsoft?
Fixed animate theme button and theme switching

Changed Easter Egg theme

Also applied some fixes to other themes

Implemented Thunderstorm Theme

Thunderstorm Theme is now animated. Not the best animations, but hey...

Added bird simulation

Bird simulation for evening theme is now fully functional!
(Also fixed problem in the animated colorful theme where the background image wouldn't display in 100% of cases)

Made sun a little heavier

... in the bliss theme

Added sun simulation features

The sun is now bouncy, able to trail and its rubber banding factor has been increased.

Added colorful theme

Also made tweaks to Bliss and enabled color schemes, meaning that themes will make sure to maintain a certain level of contrast.

Implemented animated sun theme

The animated sun theme animates around following your cursor. Also did some work to implement the infrastructure for other animated themes, which will follow soon.

Implemented animated theme button

Implemented a button that stores whether the theme animation should be played or not. Also fixed blank theme selector on first launch.

Removed unfitting theme

The Ukraine theme won't be part of DropStack anymore, as it does not align with our future plans for theming.
Also fixed a crash related to trying to load a theme that would no longer exists.

Fixed Windows Hello-related crash

We are no longer trying to load files in if the Window uses focus by trying to use Windows Hello

Also: removed unnecessary usings and
a debug statement
Added Ukrainian language

Search backplate color adjustments

The search bar backplate should now look better and align with the other panels in the app. Also added theme transitions to the backplates for when the color mode changes - however, have not managed to implement dynamic theme changes yet.

Microsoft theme removal

Microsoft theme was removed

Localization tweaks

Localizations have been updated to prevent text clipping

Merge pull request #5 from Avid29/main

Add .gitignore file so the codebase doesn't look like a mess anymore - or at least like *less* of a mess.

Alignment fixes for RTL

The previously hardcoded system that would create a space between file size and file size unit has been implemented dynamically, fixing an alignment problem for Right-To-Left languages.

Also reversed English being a test language. Also added other fixes like excluding certain UI elements from the flow direction changes to prevent them from appearing mirrored and new inclusions such as the title bar of mini mode.

Fixed a display bug with the set portal buttons

The set portal buttons previously wouldn't display properly when no folder was added - this bug was part of the localization feature, therefore was not rolled out to the public yet.

Improved music preview reliability

Music preview will more reliably pause when pressing the pause button - it will also stop when closing the details pane.
Testing RTL layout
Fixed bug causing image and video viewers to not be draggable

Settings has a maximum width and has light dismiss

Settings now has a maximum width and can be dismissed by tapping out of it.

Localization update

forgot what it was but there were some things in the localization pipeline

Added German translation

Implemented German translation to test translation capabilities. Also fixed some bugs and changed some English localization strings while I was at it.

Added window width keys and width debugging

The window can now be resized on launch and have a different default size per localization. Search can be used to obtain the current window width by typing "Window.Debug.Width"

Migrated full app to use localization

The entirety of DropStack can now be translated into a new language by modifying just one file.

Also over the last commits, I fixed some bugs and added a name field for the currently active translation but I was too focused to mention.

Fixed localization

Also mitigated possible crash when the caching file was corrupted

Migrated MainWindow.xaml to a localization file

Doesn't currently work. The reason for this commit is experimentation which may require a rollback.

Fixed context menu bug

The context menu will now no longer be too wide.

Fixed deleted file detection + crash

The app will now properly detect deleted files again and will remove them on the next soft refresh cycle - also fixed a crash related to clicking into a blank space of the ListView, causing the app to fire the ListView tapped event and checking for the selected item when there was no selected item.

Fixed details pane animation

The details pane will now correctly animate and the schortening will no longer be visible

Details Pane fixes

The command bar should no longer appear when tapping a file to reveal the details pane. Also made the play icon dynamic to change into a pause icon when playing and changes back to a play icon while paused. Also fixed some issues related to buttons being too wide and being pushed into the overflow menu, that should no longer happen.

Removed camera capabilities

The app no longer has access to the user's camera. This change is a result of deprecating the camera feature from the last commit.

Removed Camera Scanner feature

The camera scanner feature has been removed. Say goodbye to 500 lines of C# and 200 lines of XAML code.

Prevented debugging crash

The app should no longer crash directly after lauch while debugging.

Sped up animations and automated ScrollViewer

The ScrollViewer now animates automatically to the end and the animations are sped up. Also, the flash is brighter, the black background is back, the animation now layers ontop of the gallery and the shutter button is a real shutter button.

Made animations cooler

Animations in the camera scanner now look mostly good

Camera snapshots animate now

For now, the experience is very janky, but this is the ground work for more advanced animations.

Updated Readme

The Readme now reflects the app's current state rather than a mix of all patches between patch v0.4.0 and v0.6.0 - it is now updated to align with v0.6.4
Added context menu images and prepared for v0.6.4

Fixed a bug related to launch mode picking

The app should now set the default launch mode instead of leaving it blank
Fixed simple mode not being draggable properly

Fixed context menu bug

Context menu now will now always show labels to align with changes made to the Windows Insider channel
Added images for Readme update

Fixed primary portal folder setting resetting

If you deselect the primary portal folder, it will no longer automatically reselect on next launch.

Hid Camera feature for bugfix release

Also disabled webcam capability.

Fixed window handle name

Win Tab will no longer refer to DropStack as DropStack without UWP

Fixed camera memory leak

The camera now doesn't leak memory all over the place anymore.

The app should now hover around 200mb of ram usage while previewing video as opposed to the 100mb when idling on the main window.

The camera feed is now displayed in full resolution

However, the resolution is so full that the memory of your device will also be full very quickly - should be addressed soon.

Fixed reveal menu bugs

1) he reveal menu would previously offer to show the first secondary portal folder in file explorer even if this was not set - this would be displayed through a placeholder text
2) now, if no secondary folders are set, the app will no longer display two dividers in the above-mentioned menu, instead just one

Fixed settings after OOBE

Settings should now corrctly show portal folders after OOBE

Fixed another crash

This crash impacted adding a new folder on first launch right after the OOBE finished

Fixed OOBE crash

Fixed a crash that could occur during the out-of-box-experience related to the app losing focus when launching a picker and thus trying to soft reload without a set target folder.

Experimental camera UI layout change

Also potential bugfix related to the app crashing on first launch

Auto-switching from rear to front

In case there is no rear camera, the app should not automatically use the front camera.
Camera will automatically try and use the rear cam

Camera view is now working properly

Shamelessly stole code from here to make this happen:
https://github.com/TripleSM/MediaFrameCapture

Camera feed now works... occasionally

Basically, it works for two seconds after launching then it stops working. But that's better than what it previously did which was not working at all.

Laid ground work for content capture functionality

Added the necessary button and a new window dedicated to scanning things - not yet functional in any way, does receive a camera stream but does not display said camera stream.

Restored pre-commit state

The commit earlier was not intended and was a result of falsely merging a different repository with this one.

Took code from DropStack

DropStack-2 now fully builds on DropStack's codebase

Added attributions

Added an attribution to WinUIEx

Added photo file types

- .heic
- .HEIC
- .DNG

Search improvement

Search now also finds files that have the search term in the middle of the file name.

Disabled soft reload when searching

Disabled soft reload when searching or filtering files

Caching bugfix

Soft reload files are now cached more reliably, previously, DropStack would not cache these items if the maximum amount of items that it was allowed to load was exceeded.

Soft reload should now correctly add items

and no longer in the wrong order

Last minute fix for v0.6.0: File duplication bug

Fixed a bug that caused files to be duplicated in v0.6.0
Added image for v0.6.0 launch

Polishing for v0.6

Fixed bugs with recent features - a lot of them

Refresh when activating the window and a new files is detected

DropStack now checks for new files when the window is activated, if there are new files, it refreshes its content

Also more bugfixes
Keyboard shortcuts in normal mode work again

Previewing in simple and mini mode

The preview feature is now available in simple and mini mode.
To achieve this, a bug was fixed related to right-clicking the already selected item in simple mode, which would select it twice for all actions.

Context menu in normal mode

A supercharged version of the context menu is coming to normal mode

Open with dialogue now works properly

Also removed references to planned features like an expanded details view and polished the experience with bugfixes - also set the details pane to not be shown by default, it will also not be shown when double-tapping a file

Hide pinned files

There's a new option in settings to hide pinned files, also, simple mode is no longer always on top when choosing to give it free windowing.

Big launch latency improvement

After launch, it now no longer takes a second before images start loading, instead, they are loading at a speed so that all files that are visible at launch should already have their images loaded as the window opening animation finishes.

This works due to thumbnail loading and checking for new files now happening in parallel rather than in series, allowing the thumbnail loading process to start immediately after the cached FileItems are loaded, rather than having to wait for all new-to-DropStack files having to be loaded in first.

Details Pane is now Details Sheet

... and it slides in from the bottom rather than opening at the top and pushing everything away.
It can also be resized by dragging into two set positions plus it can also be dismissed by swiping down or clicking the button.

Rotating image files now possible

Rotating an image file now works with an animation and live-updating ListView!
Open files by double-clicking the preview icon

Details entrance animation + picture preview

The details pane entrance animation now doesn't look terrible anymore - also fixed sizing of the picture preview window.

Renaming now works properly

Renaming files is now reflected in the UI and correctly cached

Made details pane behavior customizable and animated

The details pane can now be toggled on an off in settings and it gently animates in an out as it's needed.

Adjusted button behavior in details view

Buttons now only appear as they are either essential or available

Added funky bouncy animation to thumbnail preview

The details pane's thumbnail image can now be slightly magnified by hovering over it.

Added a delay before compact command bar is shown

This change was made to make double tapping to open easier.

Editing file names in details pane

It now works, but the ListView isn't being updated and the file won't appear on next launch, because the caches aren't updated either due to a bug related to how DropStack finds the file in its internal indexing system.

Rename and delete in details pane

Details pane can now delete files. It may also rename them, however, the according TextBox refuses to focus.

Rudamentary previewing experiences

Photos, videos and PDF files can now be previewed by clicking the eye icon in the details pane, which can be enabled through the flags section in settings.

Audio and video preview + tagging bugfix

The details pane can now preview video and audio files with the ability to choose play/pause.

Also fixed a bug in the tagging system where audio files wouldn't be tagged as such.

Added flags page in settings

Settings now contains a flags page so you can try out experiences that are heavily under construction without having to enable them in-code when compiling the app yourself.

Combined about and settings

About and settings now live in the same panel

Introduced Text Trimming to dates in Simple Mode

the window can get narrower now

Minor reference fix

Settings no longer refers to mini mode as simple mode int he toolbar settings.

Runtime Image Caching

If a file icon has been used before while loading files, DropStack will use the same icon, rather than completely reloading it.

This does not apply to images, videos and application files, as they usually have custom icons.

Reworked Search Experience

Settings now include search leniency settings that are preserved between sessions. This value controls how lenient DropStack's file search should be in terms of typos. Basically, if this value is set to three (which is the default), DropStack will still show files in search that can be found by changing three characters in the search query. If the searched text is shorter or equal to the leniency setting, the leniency will be reduced to the search query length minus one.

Also added a short delay to search so it only refreshes when you stopped typing, which improves performance.

Added images for v0.5.1

Yes, that...

Adjusted TeachingTip position and mini mode shortcut

- teaching tips for copy success and failed drag will now appear at the top
- returning from Mini Mode to normal mode now happens with the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+M - just like how you enter it.
